title: YesStyle Black Friday 2026: has it started? This week's coupon, dates and where CECILIA010 goes

description: YesStyle's Black Friday is already on, with the Mega Sale and a tiered coupon of 8% to 15%. See where the CECILIA010 Reward Code goes and what to expect from the 15% days.
metaDescription: Does YesStyle have a Black Friday sale? Yes, it is on: Mega Sale, tiered coupon of 8% to 15% and how to stack the CECILIA010 Reward Code.

contentSections.heading: Quick answer
paragraphs: YesStyle's Black Friday has already started. CECILIA010 gives 5% on your first order and 2% on later ones, in the Reward Code field, alongside an eligible store coupon. The 15% coupon with no minimum has already appeared for the United States, the United Kingdom and Canada. Check the offer for your own destination.

contentSections.heading: The Black Friday coupon is the same as the rest of the year

image.alt: Cecília Mauad smiling with the boxes of the Abib products she received from YesStyle, in a frame from the Korean skincare routine video

paragraphs: The October 2025 tiered coupon (Mid-Season Sale) had exactly the same tiers as the November Black Friday coupon. It is the discount YesStyle runs almost all year, changing the name and the code every few days. This week's code is on the [YesStyle coupons and Reward Code](/en/coupons/yesstyle) page, because the store swaps it within days.

comparisonTable.caption: Tiers of YesStyle's tiered coupon in 2024 and 2025, the same outside and inside Black Friday. The discount applies to the price of the products.

postParagraphs: The days with no minimum have the same 15% cap. What they do is open that percentage to any cart.

contentSections.heading: How to stack CECILIA010 with the Black Friday coupon
paragraphs: YesStyle's checkout has two fields. The coupon of the day goes in Coupon Code. CECILIA010 goes in Reward Code. The rules of all the Black Friday coupons from 2024 and 2025 say they are valid together with promotional prices, with Reward Codes and with YS Points, the store's own points.

image.caption: The two checkout fields: the day's coupon on top and CECILIA010 in the Reward Code field.

bullets: Log in to your account before you build the cart: the coupons are for members only.
Build your cart and check that it reaches the tier you want (US$ 79, 149 or 199).
Paste the coupon of the day into the Coupon Code field.
Paste CECILIA010 into the Reward Code field: 5% on your first order and 2% on later ones.
Check both discounts in the order summary before you pay.

contentSections.heading: Is it worth waiting for the 15% days with no minimum?
paragraphs: First, check your delivery country. In the mid-November reading, the 15% coupon with no minimum was already available for the United States, the United Kingdom and Canada. For those destinations, there was no need to wait for Friday to get that percentage. For other destinations, the comparison below applies while the tiered coupon is in force.

image.alt: Step chart of the discount by order value at YesStyle: 0% up to US$ 79, 8% from US$ 79, 10% from US$ 149 and 15% from US$ 199, with a dashed line at 15% from US$ 0
image.caption: The green line is the tiered coupon: 8% from US$ 79, 10% from US$ 149 and 15% from US$ 199. The dashed line is a 15% coupon with no minimum, which depends on the delivery destination. Illustration by Em Casa com Cecília.

bullets: **From US$ 199:** in the dollar reference, the tiered coupon already reaches 15%. A no-minimum day would not raise that percentage; the price of each product can still change.
**From US$ 79 to under US$ 199:** the tiered coupon gives 8% or 10%. A 15% coupon with no minimum can improve the discount, if it is available for your destination.
**Under US$ 79:** the tiered coupon gives no discount. Check whether there is a no-minimum coupon for your destination before deciding to wait.

contentSections.heading: Delivery and taxes
paragraphs: Shipping and delivery time appear at checkout, and the coupon does not discount shipping. If customs charges the package on arrival, YesStyle refunds those charges on eligible orders under US$ 1,000, as store credit. Sales tax, VAT and GST are not covered, and the payment receipt must reach customer service within 30 days of its date. What the store publishes about delivery and how to ask for the refund is in the [YesStyle delivery guide](/en/reviews/yesstyle-shipping-us-uk-canada-australia).

contentSections.heading: Before you choose: dollar prices and delivery country
paragraphs: The next sections cover the products, brand by brand. All prices were read on November 16, 2026, on YesStyle's English-language store, with delivery to the United States, in US dollars. It is the promotional price of the day, almost always with the flash-deal badge, before the coupon of the week and CECILIA010. The price changes from one day to the next and from one country to another: the value that counts is the one in your bag.

On each product page, YesStyle states it is an authorized reseller of Abib, medicube, celimax, Centellian24, Dr. Althea, Beauty of Joseon and Dr. Ceuracle. On the Shiseido pages we opened, that sentence does not appear. The ingredients mentioned are those in the list published on each product page on that date; the package that arrives is the final reference.

contentSections.heading: The Abib routine Cecília tested: eyes, face and lips
paragraphs: In the video at the end of this article, Cecília tests three Abib products she received from YesStyle. They are the only ones on this list with our own experience of use, told in [Korean skincare at 30: the Abib routine](/en/reviews/korean-skincare-at-30-beginner-routine-abib-yesstyle). All three contain PDRN, and two contain retinal.

bullets: **For the eyes:** the [hydrogel patch](https://ystyle.co/cn2Z5) comes in a jar of 60 patches, which makes 30 uses for both eyes. In our reading, the page showed it as the best seller in the store's eye mask category.

**For the face:** the [Booster Crème 2.5](https://ystyle.co/q5SUZ) comes in a 30 ml tube. It is the one that takes the biggest spend of the three; the page also sells a 10 ml mini, which works for trying it before the full tube.
**For the lips:** the [Lip Mask Glazed Jelly](https://ystyle.co/TS7jZ) comes in an 11 g jar. It is the only one of the three without retinal in its ingredient list.

**Careful with retinal:** the patch and the cream contain retinal, a retinoid. Follow each product's instructions for use and wear sunscreen by day. During pregnancy, avoid retinoids. While breastfeeding, check with a health professional before using them.
**The two-pack:** all three come in a two-unit set with a bigger discount per unit. It only pays off if you already use the product.

contentSections.heading: Abib without retinoid: sheet mask and hydrating gel
paragraphs: For anyone who cannot or does not want to use retinal, Abib has two products the store itself lists among the brand's best sellers. The ingredient list published on both pages contains neither retinal nor retinol.

image.alt: The five versions of the Abib Gummy Sheet Mask, in black packaging, beside the black tube of the Hydration Gel Water Tube
image.caption: Gummy Sheet Mask and Hydration Gel Water Tube, by Abib. Product photos: YesStyle.

bullets: **Abib Gummy Sheet Mask, Madecassoside Sticker version:** a 27 g sheet mask, sold individually, at US$ 3.20 (full: US$ 4.90). The page describes this version as the one that hydrates and soothes. The same page sells four other versions: check that you picked Madecassoside before putting it in the bag.
**Abib Hydration Gel Water Tube:** a 75 ml hydrating gel, at US$ 27.30 (full: US$ 39.00), or US$ 3.64 per 10 ml. The page says it has no added fragrance and leaves a fresh, lightweight finish.

bullets: **A pad with AHA and BHA:** the Zero Pore Pad 2.0 combines these acids, according to the page, and was the best seller in the store's exfoliator category in our reading. Check the product's specific instructions for use.

**Other formulas:** the page describes the celimax pad as gentle and aimed at daily use. The Zero Pore Pad Mild is presented as the gentle version from medicube. These are the brands' descriptions, with no tolerance comparison made by us.

**Cleansing:** there is a celimax oil and a medicube foam. The cost per 100 ml is in the table, but they are different formats: choose by the use you are after. The Red Erasing Cream was out of stock in the 50 ml size, with a stated wait of about three weeks.
**Acids and retinoids:** check the products' instructions and your dermatologist's guidance before putting a combination together. We did not test this routine together.

bullets: **The store's best seller:** the 345 Relief Cream ranked first in YesStyle's overall beauty ranking in our reading, with more than 33,000 reviews. The page presents it as a cream for after acne that reduces visible redness.
**For dry skin, fragrance-free:** the 147 Barrier Cream is the one from the same brand aimed at building the hydration barrier.

**Madeca Cream has retinol:** despite its reputation as a centella cream, the Time Reverse formula contains retinol. The same care applies as with Abib's retinal products. In our reading, the 50 ml jar was out of stock, with a wait of about three weeks; the 15 ml mini cost US$ 11.25.
**A light step before the cream:** the Toning Essence Treatment is the centella option without a retinoid in the published list, in a 150 ml bottle.
**15 ml minis:** both Dr. Althea creams have a mini at US$ 8.42, useful for testing before the full jar.

postParagraphs: **The language of the page does not set the delivery country.** The US$ 79, US$ 149 and US$ 199 tiers, free standard shipping from US$ 35 and the US$ 6 shipping below that are what the store showed for delivery to the United States, in dollars. Whether you read in English from the United Kingdom, Canada, Australia or anywhere else, the conditions change with the destination: the currency, the free-shipping minimum, the coupon of the day, shipping availability and the customs tax and refund rules. Check everything at checkout, with your address, and in [YesStyle's delivery rules](https://www.yesstyle.com/en/help/section.html/hsi.732). What the store publishes by country is in the [YesStyle delivery guide](/en/reviews/yesstyle-shipping-us-uk-canada-australia).

contentSections.heading: The rules that trip people up most on Black Friday
bullets: **Members only:** if you check out as a guest, you cannot use the coupon. Create your account before the day of the promotion.
**One coupon per order:** you cannot combine two YesStyle coupons in the same order. The Reward Code is left out of that count, because it goes in another field.
**Product prices only:** the coupon does not discount shipping or other fees.
**Some products are excluded:** the product page and the checkout tell you when the coupon does not apply to it.
**The time that counts is the store's:** what matters is the time YesStyle's system records the order, in GMT. An order placed after the coupon ends gets no discount.
**You can use it more than once:** during the promotion, the same coupon is valid on as many orders as you place.

contentSections.heading: When YesStyle's Black Friday starts
paragraphs: YesStyle publishes the rules of each coupon in the site's help center, with the start and end day and time. The table below has the 2025 dates; in 2024, the phases followed the same order and started a day or two later. In 2026 the campaign has already started: on November 3, the store's home page shows the "Black Friday Mega Sale", with per-product deals and banners up to 50% off, and the tiered coupon on offer at the time (8% over US$ 79, 10% over US$ 149 and 15% over US$ 199), which the store swaps every few days, so check the current one before you buy. A coupon ending does not mean the campaign has ended. Free standard shipping over US$ 35 depends on the destination: the checkout shows yours. In mid-November, the store also released a 15% coupon on any order, with no minimum, for deliveries to the United States, the United Kingdom and Canada; for other destinations, the tiered coupon applies. The end date of the campaign and the 15% no-minimum days for all countries are not out yet.

comparisonTable.caption: Coupons open to all members in 2025, from YesStyle's help pages; each phase runs until the next one begins. Dates are in GMT, which is what counts for the store.

postParagraphs: In 2026, Black Friday falls on November 27 and Cyber Monday on November 30. If YesStyle repeats the pattern, the 15% days with no minimum should land around those two dates. This is an estimate based on past years: the store can change everything, and this guide is updated when the 2026 pages come out.
Coupons switch at a fixed time in GMT. In 2025, the tiered coupons switched at 2:00 GMT, and the 15% with no minimum started at 8:00 GMT.

contentSections.heading: Offers that are not for everyone
paragraphs: In 2025, besides the coupon open to all members, YesStyle had two restricted offers. During Black Friday week, the Bronze, Silver and Gold levels of the Elite Club, the store's loyalty program, had one product a day for US$ 1, on orders from US$ 50. One per order, while stock lasted, with no exchange or return. And between Black Friday and Cyber Monday, an 18% coupon with no minimum went to selected members ("We Miss You"). The page does not explain how those members were chosen.
If one of those coupons shows up in your account, the rule is the same: it stacks with the Reward Code and with YS Points.

contentSections.heading: After Black Friday: Christmas
paragraphs: In 2024, the biggest end-of-year coupon was not the Black Friday one: in Christmas week, YesStyle gave 18% with no minimum on everything. In 2025, the coupons open to all members stayed at 15% until the end of the year.
For Christmas gifts, compare the estimated delivery time at checkout with the date you need the order. Also check product availability.

contentSections.heading: Frequently asked questions
bullets: When does YesStyle's Black Friday start and how long does it last? It has already started: the store's home page has the Black Friday Mega Sale and a tiered coupon. YesStyle has not published the end yet; in 2024 and 2025, the coupons named Black Friday ran until Cyber Monday.
What is the YesStyle coupon on Black Friday? It changes every few days. The YesStyle page here on the site shows this week's code, with the date.

Does the YesStyle Black Friday coupon have a minimum order value? The tiered coupon does: 8% from US$ 79, 10% from US$ 149 and 15% from US$ 199. In 2024 and 2025, YesStyle opened 15% with no minimum on the days around Friday and Cyber Monday; in 2026, a 15% coupon with no minimum already appeared in mid-November for the United States, the United Kingdom and Canada, and for other countries nothing is announced yet.

Is it better to buy on Black Friday or Cyber Monday at YesStyle? In 2024 and 2025, both had 15% with no minimum, so the coupon cap was the same. What changes from one day to the next is the promotional price of each product.
Does YesStyle have promotions outside Black Friday? Yes. The tiered coupon, with 8%, 10% and 15%, runs almost all year and changes its name every few days.
Does CECILIA010 work on Black Friday? Yes. It goes in the Reward Code field, and the Black Friday coupon rules say the coupons are valid together with Reward Codes.
Can I use two YesStyle coupons on the same order? No: it is one coupon per order. The Reward Code is a different thing and goes in another checkout field.
Do I need a YesStyle account to use the Black Friday coupon? Yes. The coupons are for members only, and guest checkouts get no discount.

Will I pay tax when buying from YesStyle? There may be a charge when the package arrives. On eligible orders under US$ 1,000, YesStyle refunds the customs charges as store credit, if you send the receipt within 30 days of its date. Sales tax, VAT and GST are not covered.

What is worth buying on YesStyle's Black Friday? It depends on your routine. The guide sorts picks by need: the three Abib products Cecília tested, the exfoliating pads from medicube and celimax, the barrier creams from Centellian24 and Dr. Althea and, for glow and protection, Beauty of Joseon, Dr. Ceuracle and Shiseido.

Do the dollar prices in this guide apply to every country? No. They were read on the English-language store, with delivery to the United States. Currency, price, free shipping and the coupon of the day change with the destination: the checkout shows the conditions for your address.

Can I use Abib retinal together with exfoliating pads? Check each product's instructions for use and your dermatologist's guidance before combining acid and retinoid. We did not test this combination.
